title: Pull Out
description: A pull out shot moves physically or virtually away from the subject so more environment enters around a person or detail. Intimacy widens into context without changing lenses.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Show the container around a feeling. The person remains while the world claims them.

Unlike a zoom out, furniture and doorways can pass the lens because the camera is retreating. It is the wrong tool when you needed a high aerial to let land win, and the wrong tool when a locked optical widen would be more detached.
Define whose viewpoint the retreat represents.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Use it to show the container around a feeling. Concrete beat: a crying close coverage that retreats until the empty apartment is the sentence.
Do not pull out into a blank sky with no new fact.

sections.title: Compared with similar shots

blocks.text: A Dolly Out is this job on wheels at human height. An Aerial Pullback leaves the ground.
A Slow Zoom Out discloses context without walking. Pull out is the generic physical or virtual retreat: the container appears because we backed up.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: The Truman Show discloses the constructed world by leaving the intimate frame. The Player uses retreat as part of longer moving sentences that reveal the lot as a system.
Treat them as container grammar, not as setups to duplicate.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is a Slow Zoom Out. The tell is no parallax as the room grows.
The fix: move the camera away, fixed lens, new architecture passing the edges.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Pull Out in film?
It is a camera retreat that opens space around a subject because the station point moves away, not because the lens widens alone.
Pull Out vs Dolly Out
Dolly out names the wheeled path. Pull out is the broader retreat job and may be Steadicam, virtual, or track. Both should show parallax; a zoom out will not.
When should I use Pull Out?
When the room, street, or system around a feeling is the next sentence. Do not use it as an aerial chapter-close.
How do I prompt Pull Out for AI image or video?
Write slow pull out, camera moving away, environment entering, no optical zoom. Name the container that must appear.
